comment: Object form of the manifest. "files" lists every prefab; "groups" declares settlements. A prefab joins a group with a top-level "group": "<name>". Grouped prefabs never spawn on their own.

village._doc: count = buildings per village, radius = how far they scatter from the centre, spacing = minimum gap between footprints, path = the block paths are paved with.

catacomb._doc: rooms = how many chambers, corridor = gap between rooms that the tunnel spans, spread = radius of chunks the dungeon claims.
